text:
zoe: quick pulse — want a lightweight launch card for the benchmark writeup. goal: one image that works as OG, in-email header, and webinar cover.

marco: got it. visual idea?

zoe: single-row layout: tiny latency spark (median + p95), center mini-scatter (latency vs $/1k) with bands for tiering, right micro-bar showing % savings stack (batching, quant, cache). no heavy grids.

rita: sounds clean. can we show a tiny callout for short-seq performance? many chat teams care about <64 tokens.

devon: yes — callouts from our run: median=72ms/token, p95=240ms/token, baseline=$0.29/1k, post-opt=$0.10/1k. i'll drop csv in /marketing/bench_exports/bench_5209876543.csv.

marco: will mock two OG versions in figma: one with % deltas, one with absolute $. link: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-benchcard.

zoe: prefer % for hero, but include a tiny table in the blog with $ baseline for downstream folks. keep OG overlay text <60 chars.

ops-bot: Reminder: OG image 1200x630 px min. Include alt text and caption for accessibility.

rita: copy options for social: A) "Ship predictable inference: faster where it matters, cheaper where it doesn't." B) "Benchmark: speed and savings for production apps." which lands?

devon: A resonates more with product message. B can be used in the webinar invite.

sales-ops: routing note — use UTM bench_card_q2_26. demo CTA -> SDR queue; enterprise interest -> tag "bench-enterprise" and route to AEs. we'll add hidden field `bench_cohort=card_v1`.

marco: timeline: csv uploaded (devon), figma frames by tomorrow 9am (marco), hero draft copy by zoe by 11am, blog publish target next Wed. devon, flag if numbers shift.

zoe: good. also one transparency line in footer: "Tests run on public model Y on standard GPU; results vary by workload." short and clear.

rita: i'll prep two headline variants for A/B in the email.

devon: uploaded csv and added a short README in that folder with run config.

zoe: awesome. ship it :rocket:
